frozen: 2026-10-02, before any fit of the network on real data (commit recorded by the run)
author: Claude Code, session 22d21f (R-LEAD P4)
question: Does a NONLINEAR correction of the out-of-fold transfer, conditioned on the held-out line's controls, beat its context-free twin and the simple calibration on line groups held out whole?
why_now: P3 (p3_decision_cj_r1) excluded linear per-gene gains and low-rank bilinear corrections; M2 chose the largest rank in 6/7 folds. This is the falsifiable nonlinear version on the same bench, inputs and rows; if it fails, the limit is the data (lines), not the model form, and no GPU training on the same inputs is justified.
bench: same cube (cube_r1), same 7 groups held out whole, same OOF transfers and evaluated rows as p3_c_r2
architecture: y_hat[r, j] = MLP_gene([s, isnan(s), m, d, level, low, E_j]) + sum_k U[j, k] * MLP_program([U^T s_r, phi(c)])_k; MLP_gene 14 -> 32 -> 32 -> 1, MLP_program 19 -> 64 -> 16, SiLU; U = top-16 gene basis of the training transfers; phi = top-3 principal coordinates of training controls; E = learned gene embedding (8)
twin: nn0: the same network trained on the same rows with the context replaced by the sources' reference profile (d = 0, level and low of the sources, phi = 0)
loss: expression-weighted squared error on finite truth (weights of the row's own controls), 1,024 random genes per row per step, rows drawn group -> table -> row (each training group equally likely)
selection: steps chosen on an inner validation group held out whole (the training group first in sha256 order of 'nn-val:<held group>'), with its own transfers, basis and PCA rebuilt without it; nn0 and nn choose their steps separately; the three nulls reuse the steps chosen for nn (compute); each arm is then refitted on all six training groups

metrics.why_primary: P3 showed that cos rewards re-adding the common response that the recipe's transfer removes; cos_spec (prediction and truth centred over the block's targets) measures the target-specific correction

rule_C_context.c1: macro delta(cos_spec) nn - nn0 > 0 and > max of the 3 permuted-control nulls
rule_C_context.c3: nn - nn_swap > 0 in macro and in at least 5 of 7 groups
rule_C_context.c4: no secondary worse than the worst null
rule_C_context.pass: c1 and c2 and c3 and c4

rule_C_chain.h1: macro(arm - reference)(cos_spec) > 0 and > 0 in at least 6 of 7 groups
rule_C_chain.h2: no macro regression on any secondary metric against the reference
rule_C_chain.pass: h1 and h2 against BOTH transfer and tm0 (taken from p3_c_r2 on the same rows)

outcomes.context_benefit: nn passes the context rule: specify the GPU cellular version with the same rule and a P5 reserve
outcomes.chain_improvement_without_context: nn0 passes the chain rule against transfer and tm0: a production calibration candidate, judged on six members and P5
outcomes.no_benefit: nonlinearity does not help with these inputs: next is data (more linked lines), not a larger network on the same inputs

seeds: one seed in this pass; three seeds for any arm that passes, before any adoption
compute_note: measured before freezing (22:33): 156 ms per step at 64 x 1,024 with 4 threads, 82 ms at 32 x 1,024 with 8 threads on this laptop; the grid is capped at 2,000 steps so the seven folds run in about two hours
